insurer: Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Limited

room_rent.note: Room rent capped at Private Single A/C Room (most economical single occupancy AC room); proportionate deduction applies on associated medical expenses if higher room is taken.

icu.note: ICU charges are explicitly listed as covered without a separate sub-limit; proportionate deduction does not apply to ICU charges per policy wording.

copayment.note: 10% co-payment on every claim for insured persons who enter the policy at age 61 or above. No co-payment for those who entered before 61 and renew continuously.

sub_limits.display: Modern treatments sub-limited; maternity, bariatric, home care capped
sub_limits.note: Modern treatments (robotic surgery, deep brain stimulation, oral chemo, monoclonal antibody, intravitreal injections, etc.) have SI-linked sub-limits. Bariatric: ₹2.5L–₹5L. Home care: 10% of SI up to ₹5L. Maternity: fixed limits per SI slab. OPD consultation: small fixed limits.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; not applicable for accidents.

ped_waiting.note: Base PED waiting period is 36 months. Reducible to 12 months via optional paid 'Buy Back of PED Waiting Period' add-on available only at first purchase.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Extensive list including cataract, ENT, thyroid, hernia, joint replacements, gallbladder, kidney stones, varicose veins, uterine diseases, prostate, hydrocele, haemorrhoids, transplants, etc.

maternity.note: Inbuilt cover for normal delivery (₹15k–₹1L), C-section (₹20k–₹1L), newborn cover up to ₹1L–₹2L, vaccination up to ₹5k–₹10k. 24-month waiting period. Available only when both self and spouse are covered for 24 continuous months.

cumulative_bonus.note: For SI ₹5L: 50% per claim-free year up to 100%. For SI ₹7.5L and above: 100% per claim-free year, max 100% of basic SI. Bonus reduces proportionately on claims.

restoration.note: Automatic restoration of 100% of basic SI once per policy period upon full exhaustion of basic SI and cumulative bonus. Restored SI can be used even for the same illness/disease for which prior claim was made.

day_care.note: All day-care treatments covered up to sum insured.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation covered for illness exceeding 3 days. Several conditions excluded (asthma, bronchitis, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy, etc.).

ayush.note: AYUSH in-patient treatment covered up to sum insured. Yoga and Naturopathy require prior company approval.

organ_donor.note: Donor hospitalisation expenses covered up to basic SI (additional over limit of coverage). Donor's complications requiring redo surgery/ICU also covered.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance at actuals for transport to hospital, between hospitals, or home (same city with doctor certificate). Air ambulance up to ₹2.5L per hospitalisation, max ₹5L per policy period.

modern_treatments.note: Covered but with SI-linked sub-limits per procedure per policy period (e.g. robotic surgery, deep brain stimulation, oral chemo, monoclonal antibody injections, intravitreal injections, stem cell transplant, etc.).

consumables.note: Non-medical consumables (gloves, syringes, etc.) are subsumed into room/procedure charges per the annexure but not separately payable as a benefit; no consumables rider mentioned.

global_cover.note: Policy territorial limit is India only. Personal accident section (II.23) applies worldwide but health treatment is India-only.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage, no claim can be contested except on grounds of established fraud.

grace_period.note: 30 days grace for annual/half-yearly/quarterly premium; 15 days for monthly instalment. Coverage available during grace period if premium paid in instalments.

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only, not on renewals or portability.

portability.note: IRDAI-compliant portability; credits for PED waiting, specific waiting periods, moratorium transferred to new insurer.

notable_exclusions.display: Cochlear implants, CPAP/BIPAP, hearing aids, wheelchairs; EECP/chelation/hyperbaric O2; PRP/platelet injections; biologicals (outpatient); circumcision/preputioplasty

optional_riders.display: Buy Back of PED Waiting Period (36mo→12mo, first purchase only)
